ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; visible pixels consist of approximately 70% high-intensity white and 30% low-intensity black/dark grey pigmentation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central fields on both lobes. The right lobe contains two distinct, high-contrast dark elliptical focal spots in the upper-mid white region. A thick black contiguous band extends from the median notch towards the center of the right lobe. Both lobes exhibit continuous black margins along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; base of the notch is partially obscured by water spray, but visible edges indicate a pixel-depth of approximately 12% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the entire visible trailing edge boundary, with pixel amplitudes varying between 3 to 15 pixels in depth relative to the linear edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on both lobes tapering to sharp, pointed distal tips; the right lobe displays a broader horizontal aspect than the visible left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent dark circular pixel clusters on the right lobe white field. Multiple smaller, punctate dark clusters are visible across the medial region of the left lobe white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear dark pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the left lobe white field, oriented from the trailing edge inward.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography with deep notches near the distal tips, indicating historical physical wear or minor traumatic removals.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific spatial configuration of the two dark spots on the right lobe creates a unique, face-like ocular pattern.
